# x402 JSON Canonicalizer

> Produce deterministic JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS-style / RFC 8785) output. Stable key order, no insignificant whitespace, number normalization. Essential for signing and content-addressing. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/canonicalize
  - Input: `{ "data": any JSON-serializable value }` or raw JSON body
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "result": "canonical string", "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.007 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Deterministic payload identity for multi-agent consensus
- Pre-hash / pre-sign preparation
- Cache keys and content-addressable storage
- Token-efficient, pure logic
